Clear & Welcoming

Frequently Asked Questions

How RSVP works, upfront costs, language support, and institutional partnerships.

Email phungsu@holarise.org ↗

HolaRise welcomes university students, international exchange students, young professionals in Hoa Lac High-Tech Park, and anyone who values grounded community. Weekly sessions are primarily in Vietnamese unless marked bilingual, and English-speaking coordinators are happy to welcome you.

Pick a gathering on the Schedule page, enter your name and phone, Zalo, or email in 15 seconds (no password needed), then add the event to your calendar or join the session's Zalo group for location pins and carpool updates.

View schedule & upfront costs →

More than half of first-time guests arrive solo. A coordinator welcomes you at the door, and you are completely free to listen without being pressured to speak.

Admission is free. For gatherings hosted at partner cafes, you simply cover your own drink (typically 35,000–50,000 VND). Any shared material cost is always listed upfront on the invitation.

View schedule & upfront costs →

Use the Institutional Partnership tab on this page, email phungsu@holarise.org directly, or message our coordinator hotline/Zalo at 077.777.1948.
